title: Valentine single-page prompt with evasive No button and success meme

requirements.summary: Implement a single-purpose Valentine prompt screen with a clear question and two prominent buttons labeled "Yes" and "No".
acceptanceCriteria: On load, the page shows a single clear prompt asking to be the user’s Valentine.
Two buttons are visible and labeled exactly "Yes" and "No".
No other primary flows/pages are presented (single-purpose experience).

file_operations.description: Create the single-page React UI for the Valentine prompt with the question and two buttons labeled exactly "Yes" and "No". Use the shadcn-ui Button component to provide consistent, prominent button styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the app renders the single-purpose Valentine prompt App component (keep the experience single-page and client-side).

requirements.summary: Add an evasive interaction to the "No" button that repositions on hover (desktop) and on touch/pointerdown (iPad/touch) to prevent clicking while staying visible and not breaking layout.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, moving the cursor onto/near the "No" button causes it to reposition so it cannot be clicked.
On iPad/touch devices, attempting to tap the "No" button (e.g., touchstart/pointerdown) causes it to reposition before a click is registered.
The "No" button remains visible on screen after moving (it does not disappear entirely).
The interaction does not break page layout (no overlapping unreadable text or inaccessible "Yes" button).

file_operations.description: Create a small hook/utility that computes safe in-bounds positions for the evasive "No" button within a containing element, with logic to avoid overlapping the "Yes" button area and to keep the button fully visible on common desktop and iPad viewport sizes.

Wire the evasive behavior to the "No" button using pointer/mouse hover handlers for desktop and pointerdown/touchstart handlers for iPad/touch so the button repositions before a click is registered; keep layout readable and ensure the "Yes" button remains accessible. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the "No" button UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: On clicking "Yes", transition to a success state that displays a meme image containing the exact text "Good choice ❤" and is clearly visible on desktop and iPad Chrome.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the "Yes" button transitions the UI to a success state.
The success state displays the meme image.
The meme image visibly contains the exact text: "Good choice ❤".
After clicking "Yes", the user is not required to do additional steps to see the meme (it is immediately shown).

file_operations.description: Implement client-side success state: when the user clicks "Yes", replace/overlay the prompt with an image render of frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1200x1200.png and ensure the success view is sized/responsive for desktop and iPad Chrome. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the "Yes" button UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive romantic pink-and-white theme with consistent typography, spacing, and subtle decorative accents while keeping the layout simple and readable on iPad.
acceptanceCriteria: The primary background and UI styling follow a pink-and-white romantic theme (no dominant non-theme colors).
The UI looks intentionally designed (consistent fonts, button styling, spacing).
The page remains readable and usable on iPad Chrome viewport sizes.

file_operations.description: Add global styling (or Tailwind base layer overrides) to establish a pink-and-white romantic theme, cohesive typography, spacing, and subtle decorative accents (e.g., soft heart motifs) while preserving readability on iPad-sized viewports.
Extend/adjust Tailwind theme tokens as needed to support the romantic pink-and-white palette and consistent typography/spacing utilities used by the single Valentine page.

Apply the romantic theme in the single-page layout (background, spacing, typography, decorative accents) while keeping the UI focused on the Valentine question and ensuring iPad Chrome responsiveness.

requirements.summary: Add the generated meme image as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated and render it directly from the frontend without backend fetching.
acceptanceCriteria: The meme image file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filename specified in imageRequirements.required.
The frontend references the static file path and renders the image without backend involvement.
The image loads correctly in the built app without requiring external URLs.

file_operations.description: Add the required generated static meme image asset with the exact filename and dimensions: frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1200x1200.png.
Reference and render the static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1200x1200.png directly in the success state (no backend involvement).
